title: A Novel Strategy in Managing Spent Probiotic Culture Media: Metabolome Identified Functional Candidates Against Hyperuricemia.
authors: Zhang, Hongyu; Wang, Da; Cao, Xiangheng; Zheng, Baiyu; Qiu, Ruiyang; Xu, Wenhui; Duan, Koukou; Wei, Shuping; Zhao, Mengge; Han, Shichao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究益生菌废培养基代谢物抗高尿酸血症，涉及分子对接但对象为代谢物-酶/转运体，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: With the rapid expansion of the probiotics industry, the management of spent culture media has emerged as a pressing concern. However, it also represents a potential resource for functional food development. In this study, we investigated and screened anti-hyperuricemia (HUA) metabolites of Lactobacillus paracasei (LP) from spent media (META). Administration of META significantly reduced serum uric acid (UA) (SUA) levels (p < 0.05), improved kidney function, and alleviated inflammatory infiltration. Furthermore, META modulated UA metabolism by regulating key enzymes (xanthine oxidase [XOD] and adenosine deaminase [ADA]) and urate transporters (organic anion transporter 3 [OAT3], glucose transporter 9 [GLUT9], and urate transporter 1 [URAT1]), while mitigating HUA-induced inflammation through the Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)/nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) pathway. To identify bioactive compounds, untargeted metabolomics based on UHPLC-QTOF-MS/MS detected 361 upregulated metabolites. Network pharmacology and molecular docking (MD) analyses further highlighted potential candidates, including 2-isopropylmaleate and ricinoleic acid methyl ester. Collectively, these findings suggest that probiotic culture media waste may serve as a promising natural source for the development of anti-HUA functional foods. Further studies are warranted to assess the bioavailability and efficacy of these metabolites both in vitro and in vivo.
abstract_zh: 随着益生菌产业的快速扩张，废弃培养基的管理已成为一个紧迫的问题。然而，它同时也代表着功能性食品开发的潜在资源。在本研究中，我们调查并筛选了副干酪乳杆菌（Lactobacillus parasei，LP）废弃培养基（META）中的抗高尿酸血症（HUA）代谢物。给予META显著降低了血清尿酸（UA）水平（p < 0.05），改善了肾功能，并减轻了炎症浸润。此外，META通过调节关键酶（黄嘌呤氧化酶 [XOD] 和腺苷脱氨酶 [ADA]）及尿酸盐转运蛋白（有机阴离子转运蛋白3 [OAT3]、葡萄糖转运蛋白9 [GLUT9] 和尿酸盐转运蛋白1 [URAT1]）来调控UA代谢，同时通过Toll样受体4（TLR4）/核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）通路缓解HUA诱导的炎症。为鉴定生物活性化合物，基于UHPLC-QTOF-MS/MS的非靶向代谢组学检测到361种上调代谢物。网络药理学和分子对接（MD）分析进一步突出了潜在候选物，包括2-异丙基苹果酸和蓖麻油酸甲酯。总体而言，这些发现表明益生菌培养基废弃物可能作为开发抗HUA功能性食品的有前景的天然来源。未来需进一步研究以评估这些代谢物在体外和体内的生物利用度及功效。
